description: A Frost and physical brawler who improves everyone standing nearby just by being there - standing auras, a summoned ancestor, and a party haste cooldown on top of a real melee rotation.
_source_note: Built from reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_barbarian__ancestry.txt and the ancestry block of reference/coa_sidekick/talents/barbarian.json. CoA calls it 'the closest to retail Enhancement Shaman' - 'a melee DPS spec wearing support clothing via auras and a haste cooldown, not a healer' - and its own summary is 'You buff your side just by showing up.' Three translations run through the whole tree. The Tankard/Fill Level second resource does not exist (CLASS_RESOURCE_MAP gives this class one pool), so every empty-versus-full gate is gone and Fill Level and Liquid Courage become pool size and flat mitigation. The party auras are CAST abilities, because a talent effect can only ever reach its own owner, and the talent versions grant the Barbarian its share. And the Frost half of the kit runs on Frozen Warlord's attack-power conversion, which is CoA's own explanation for how a class with no magic deals Frost damage.

nodes.name: Trip to the Alehouse
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Keg Smash by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Keg Smash by 10% and its range by 3 yds', and the rotation's step 2 is 'Keg Smash on cooldown (boosted by Trip to the Alehouse)'. Range is not a concept in a turn fight.

nodes.name: Drinking Frenzy
nodes.description: Increases your hit rating by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your melee attacks now have a 15% chance to grant a stack of Fill Level. In addition, your chance to hit is increased by 5%'. Hit leads this spec's stat priority; Fill Level has no pool to fill.

nodes.name: Fill Level
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 6 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA free passive: 'Grants you Fill Level and the ability to manipulate a Tankard. You have a magical Tankard that fills up over time ... Some of your other abilities empty your Tankard to trigger with a reduced cooldown.' CLASS_RESOURCE_MAP gives Barbarian (ENERGY, None) - no secondary pool - so the Tankard is gone and the node widens the pool it does have. Every Tankard GATE in the kit (Breath of the North needs empty, Ale of the God-King needs full) is dropped with it.

nodes.name: Frozen Warlord
nodes.description: Grants spell power equal to 2% of your attack power per rank.
nodes._source: CoA class tree names Frozen Warlord and Hodir's Wrath as the Frost half of a class with 'no magic of their own', and Ale of the God-King and Clanlord's Totem both say their Frost damage scales 'with your attack power'. This is the node that makes that literally true: a real <target>_from_<source>_pct conversion, and the reason Breath of the North, Frozen Tankard and Hodir's Wrath scale at all - spell_damage reads get_effective_spell_power, which is otherwise zero on a leather Agility melee. Take it first. The freeze-in-place half of CoA's wording has no hook.

nodes.name: Improved Ancestral Combat
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Ancestral Combat by 2 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of your Ancestral Combat by -10 and allows it to trigger 3 additional times'. ability_<id>_cost is a flat reduction, so 5/5 reaches CoA's own -10. The trigger count is the buff's duration here and is not separately scalable.

nodes.name: Ice Cold Bubbles
nodes.description: Increases your Frost damage by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each Fill Level stack now also increases Frost damage dealt by 2%'. <school>_damage_pct is assembled at runtime in _school_damage_bonus and resolved against the school the cast actually deals, so this only touches the spec's Frost abilities - which is the point.

nodes.name: Thane's Guard
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Gain the Shield proficiency and while wearing a shield you gain 40% increased attack speed and 100% increased Armor contribution from your shield'. Proficiency lives in data/items/weapon_types.json, which is shared data this script does not touch, and Barbarian has no shield there - so the node keeps the armour it was for. armor_pct is PERCENT POINTS (divided by 100 in _recalculate_derived_stats), unlike max_health_pct.

nodes.name: Liquid Courage
nodes.description: Reduces all damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each Fill Level stack now reduces your damage taken by -2%', and the strengths list pairs it with Ramhorn Rage as the reason 'No healer required'. Flat rather than per-stack, since the stacks are gone with the Tankard. As a TALENT effect damage_taken_pct is a fraction.

nodes.name: Cold Brew
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to return 10 Energy.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Frost damage now generate a stack of Fill Level. Can only occur once per sec.' A Fill Level stack is gone, so the proc hands back the resource the spec actually spends. The once-per-second limit is icd 1. Not restricted to Frost crits - ability_filter names abilities, not schools.

nodes.name: Blind Stupor
nodes.description: Your Keg Smash leaves enemies reeling, reducing their attack power by 25.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Keg Smash now reduces enemies' casting speed by -30%'. There is no cast-speed stat on a Monster - it reads only armor and attack_power out of a status effect - so the stupor takes the swing out of them instead, which is the closest thing to it that lands.

nodes.name: Unified Rage
nodes.description: Your Unbridled Rage lasts 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Unbridled Rage now increases your chance to trigger Ancestral Combat by 25%'. A talent cannot raise another talent-free buff's proc chance, so the node buys uptime on the window instead. The sibling CoA class talent Unstoppable Rage ('+2 sec duration of Unbridled Rage') is the same effect, so the name it carries is real.

nodes.name: Hodir's Revenge
nodes.description: Your Frozen Tankard leaves enemies exposed, reducing their armor by 40.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Enemies damaged by your Frozen Tankard now take 50% increased damage from you for 6 seconds'. A damage-taken-increase debuff does nothing to a Monster (see Horde Breaker), so it lands as armour shred - and Frozen Tankard opens the pull, which is when a shred is worth most.

nodes.name: Icebound Ancestry
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Breath of the North by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike chance of Breath of the North by 10%. In addition, your attacks now ignore Armor against Frozen targets.' The Frozen flag Frozen Tankard sets has no hook, so only the crit half lands - and that half is a real per-ability crit key.

nodes.name: Frost Giant's Fury
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Breath of the North now grants you 10% melee attack speed, plus an additional 20% when using a two-handed weapon, for 8 seconds'. A talent cannot attach a buff to another ability's cast, and there is no weapon-type condition, so it is flat haste at the shipped per-rank scale. Haste is this spec's second stat priority.

nodes.name: The Spins
nodes.description: Increases your ancestor's damage by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Keg Smash now causes your Honored Ancestor to perform an Ancestral Whirl attack upon nearby enemies'. Nothing makes a pet mirror the owner's cast, so the extra attacks become the damage they were worth. pet_damage is read in entities/pet.py.

nodes.name: Breaking Morale
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your abilities by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of Break by -15'. Break is the To The Bone debuff from the Headhunting tree, which is not an ability here, so the reduction goes to the pool it was always paying from.

nodes.name: Might of Utgarde
nodes.description: Increases your ancestor's health by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Attacks from your Ancestral Combat now heal your Honored Ancestor for 5% maximum health and cause it to perform an Ancestral Whirl attack'. There is no pet-heal proc, so the node keeps the ancestor alive the other way.

nodes.name: Frozen Blades
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes now grant party and raid members 5% critical strike chance for 8 seconds'. A talent effect only ever applies to its owner - get_talent_effects feeds the owner's bonus pool and nothing else - so the party-facing half is the cast ability of the same name and this node is the Barbarian's own share.

nodes.name: Ancestor's Fury
nodes.description: Increases your Frost critical strike damage by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Unbridled Rage now also increases your Frost damage by 10%'. The during-Unbridled-Rage condition is not expressible; the burst flavour survives as crit damage rather than a second flat Frost increase on top of Ice Cold Bubbles. <school>_crit_damage_pct is resolved per cast in _crit_damage_bonus.

nodes.name: Rage of the North
nodes.description: Increases your Frost spell power by 8 per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the amount of attacks that can trigger your Ale of The God-King by 10'. No hook for that, so the node does the other thing the spec's late tier wants: more Frost behind every cast. Stacks additively with Frozen Warlord's conversion in get_effective_spell_power.

nodes.name: Uniting Voice
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1 and your healing done by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA free passive: 'Casting Ancestral Roar now increases haste of party and raid members by 5% for 20 seconds'. Party scope is not available to a talent (see Frozen Blades), so the haste is the Barbarian's own and the node also scales Ancestral Roar itself, which is the ability CoA hangs it on.

nodes.name: Clanlord's Totem
nodes.description: Increases all damage you deal by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA free passive: the totem makes 'allied players within 100 yds deal 35% AP additional damage as Frost'. The placed totem is the cast ability of the same name; this node is the Barbarian's own share of it, same split as Frozen Blades and Uniting Voice.

nodes.name: Fury of the North
nodes.description: Something older than you takes the fight over for a while. +6% Frost damage, +3 haste and +4% maximum health.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Increases the duration of the enrage effect from your Ramhorn Rage by 6 sec and causes it to increase your movement speed by 40% for its duration'. Movement speed is nothing here and a duration extension is a small capstone, so it carries the three things the spec is built on at once: Frost, haste and the health to stand in melee. max_health_pct is a FRACTION - 0.04 is +4%, not +400%.
